We're always excited to connect with experienced Growth Product Managers who are passionate about gaming, highly analytical, and excited about a game's commercial success across mobile and PC.

If you bring together creativity, planning, and data-driven insights, we'd love to hear that you are interested in future opportunities at Outfit7.

If you are someone who:

• Has experience in growth, user acquisition, product marketing, publishing, or related commercial roles within the gaming industry.
• Has strong understanding of mobile user acquisition, including performance marketing channels.
• Has experience analyzing key growth and monetization metrics..
• Has familiarity with app store optimization, localization processes, and mobile game distribution.
• Has experience managing communities across player-facing channels.

We encourage you to join our talent pool and be among the first to be considered when an opportunity arises.

Apply today and stay connected with us!
